name: Castelfiorentino (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Castelfiorentino (a fleur-de-lis on white beneath a red chief) within branches, with the inscription CASTELFIORENTINO in yellow above.
history: Municipal flag of Castelfiorentino, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Castelfiorentino arms — fleur-de-lis on white beneath a red chief, crowned, within branches
